summary: Make host cutover aware of a separate daemon store directory

schema.detail: No schema, journal or receipt changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Host migration reads store_dir from daemon configuration and accepts matching --config, --state-dir and --store-dir overrides. A separate store stays external or moves only with its ordinary legacy root. Committed reruns allow exactly the configured store mount; other product-root mounts still refuse. Database-trio symlinks, including dangling links, refuse before service stops and are rechecked under the store fence before exchanges; ancestor product-root bridges remain supported.

downtime.detail: Store path validation happens before stopping services; reachability is checked again after root exchanges. After service stop, the mover holds the store directory-FD fence through exchanges without creating store files; a concurrent owner refuses the swap and restores legacy services.

manual.detail: Pass the running daemon unit's configuration overrides to migrate host. Complete cutover without product-root mounts before relocating only the SQLite database trio to a nested dataset with a daemon-only stop. See docs/st3/macos-installation.md.

recovery.detail: Rollback refuses mounted product roots and submounts with unmount guidance before mutation. The existing refusal to roll back a committed API probe remains. The mover never copies or separately moves store files.
